answers.goal: The ultimate goal for me is to establish myself as a cinematographer. I want to create visuals that make audiences feel emotions that are difficult to put into words. Beyond that, I want to build a community of hardworking individuals who create for the love of the art not just for recognition.
answers.drew: I’ve always had a passion for photography and have always been curious as to how movies were made. One day I tried videography and quickly realized how much more emotion and meaning can be conveyed through moving images versus still photographs. From that moment on, I wanted to learn everything I could about filmmaking. I’ve worked on every set I can, and I am addicted to the energy of being on set, and bringing stories to life behind the camera.
answers.seeking: I would love to connect with other individuals who work or aspire to work behind the camera! Also Producers, I’d love to hear about new projects in the works.
answers.inspiration: One of my inspirations is cinematographer Alice Brooks! #Wicked
